## Migrator.status() method

Which migrations exist, and which have run.

**Signature:**

```typescript
status(): Promise<MigrationStatus[]>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[MigrationStatus](./database.migrationstatus.md)<!-- -->\[\]&gt;

## Remarks
